thread:
maria: Acme verbally committed to a 3mo POC. Need a short capacity plan (reserved GPUs + autoscale ceiling/floor), pricing delta for presales (4/6/8 reserved), and security answers (KMS/VPC/logs) by EOD. who can own throughput shape?

ben: paging @carla @dmitri. whats avg vs peak?

carla: profile: chat + embed mix. steady ~250 QPS, bursts to ~2k QPS for 10-20s, median tokens/request ~140, 95p latency target 300ms. model = 13B q4.

dmitri: quick calc: steady tokens/s = 250*140 = 35k. measured 13B-q4 throughput ~18k toks/s per GPU -> baseline = ceil(35k/18k)=2 -> add 20% headroom => 3 GPUs steady. burst 2k qps -> 280k toks/s -> naive need ~16 GPUs. with KV caching + microbatching we often get 2-3x effective reduction -> optimistic ~6 GPUs. recommend reserved options: 4 (cost-opt), 6 (balanced), 8 (safe). autoscale ceiling 12-16 depending on cache behavior.

ben: sample autoscale snippet for presales doc:
autoscale_policy: min_reserved=4; max_scale=16; metric=tokens_per_sec; scale_up_at=0.75; cool_down=2m; preheat=true; fallback_model=7B-q4

carla: sales also wants cost delta 4 vs 6 vs 8 and a fallback plan for legal. dmitri: can you summarize risks and fallbacks?

dmitri: risk matrix: reserved4 = cheapest but higher autoscale reliance; reserved6 = balanced; reserved8 = lower risk. fallbacks: 1) autoscale to burst pool (spot+reserved mix); 2) degrade to 7B quantized variant (~2x throughput); 3) soft-throttle (429 + Retry-After) with client guidance. include KV warmup checklist to reduce burst impact.

carla: i'll assemble POC runbook: recommended reserve=4, autoscale->12 with burst credits, cost table for 4/6/8, autoscale snippet, KV warmup steps, and security one-pager.

maria: timeline: need draft for presales by 1700 PT. can you confirm?

ben: will paste perf numbers by 1500.

dmitri: will attach security one-pager and preheat commands by 1600.

ops-bot: preheat job queued: job_id=preheat-5498765432-1 target_gpus=4 kv_warmup=true

maria: thanks team, i'll update the customer and loop in finance. :thumbsup:
